name: alpkit-store.github.io
description: A GitHub Pages site hosting internal tool documentation (e.g. Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon, and order management tools).
summary: Keeps an up-to-date public website that showcases Alpkit's internal tools by automatically collecting and summarizing documentation from multiple repositories. Team members who manage internal tools or want to share their work can easily publish or update documentation without manual effort. It removes the hassle of maintaining separate documentation sites and ensures summaries are easy to understand and organized by category.
